description: Source code for a utility that converts SREC files to binary format, including handling of endianness and checksum verification.

methods.description: Placeholder for displaying hexadecimal values (currently commented out).

methods.name: WaitDisplay
methods.description: Displays a rotating indicator periodically if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: binOut32
methods.description: Outputs a 32-bit value to the binary file, handling endianness.

methods.name: binOut8
methods.description: Outputs an 8-bit value to the binary file, updating record length.

methods.name: srecLine
